display_rules: Winner remains UNDECIDED even where scoreboard lead is large.
Lineup points are player-level week-to-date, not evidence of NFL game completion.
A zero-point player is not automatically an inactive or unplayed player.
Bench points do not prove an eligible, timely lineup substitution could have occurred.
Bench ranks must not be used as retrospective legal-substitution valuations without slot/lock validation.
